public.title: Longest Valid Parentheses
public.description: Return the length of the longest contiguous balanced-parentheses substring. text contains only ( and ) and has length 0 to 1000.
hints: Keep unmatched opening indices and a base index before the current valid region.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: After a matching close, distance from the last unmatched index gives a valid suffix length. O(n) time and space.
